armySpecialRules.name: CHAOS ARMOUR
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule cannot have their armour save reduced below a 6+ save from non-magical Attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: ENSORCELLED WEAPONS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule gain the Armour Piercing (1) and Magical Attacks special rules when using hand weapons.

armySpecialRules.name: DAEMONIC
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule have the Fear, Magical Attacks, and Magical Ward (5+) special rules.
In addition, a Daemon can have any of the following in addition to the rules above:
• Daemon of Khorne: A Daemon of Khorne has the Hatred (Daemons of Slaanesh), Magic Resistance (1) and Mighty Blow (1) special rules.
• Daemon of Nurgle: A Daemon of Nurgle has the Hatred (Daemons of Tzeentch) and Poisoned Attacks special rules. Enemy models in base contact suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill.
• Daemon of Tzeentch: A Daemon of Tzeentch has the Hatred (Daemons of Nurgle) a Magical Ward (6+) special rules. Wizards with the Daemon of Tzeentch upgrade can also re-roll channelling results of 1.
• Daemon of Slaanesh: A Daemon of Slaanesh has the Hatred (Daemons of Khorne) and Armour Piercing (1) special rules. For every close combat Attack that causes an unsaved Wound, the model may may an additional Attack. These additional Attacks cannot generate further attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: EYE OF THE GODS
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule can never refuse a challenge and, if possible, must always issue one. If there are several models with this special rule involved in a combat, the controlling player chooses which will issue/accept the challenge.
In addition, if a model with this special rule kills an enemy character or destroys a non-Expendable unit in either close combat, with spells, or through charging/pursuing, immediately make a roll on the Eye of the Gods table.
If there is more than one character with this special rule in the unit at the time of the destruction of the enemy unit through pursuit, each character gets to make a separate roll.
Once the result of the roll has been determined, make a note on your army roster – that model now has that Gift of the Gods (see pages 10-12) for the rest of the battle.
A model can have several Gifts of the Gods, but can only have each Gift once. If a Gift cannot be applied, the roll has no effect.
D6 | Result
1 | Pick one Gift of the Gods worth 5 points.
2 | Pick one Gift of the Gods worth 10 points.
3 | Pick one Gift of the Gods worth 15 points.
4 | Pick one Gift of the Gods worth 20 points.
5 | Pick one Gift of the Gods worth 25 points.
6 | Pick one Gift of the Gods worth 30 points.

armySpecialRules.name: MARKS OF CHAOS
armySpecialRules.description:
Many characters and units in the Warriors of Chaos army have, or can purchase, one of the four Marks of Chaos detailed below.
Unless your Army General has the same Mark of Chaos, any Core Unit with Mark of Chaos counts as Special Units, Special Units counts as Rare Units, and Rare Units may not be included.
In addition, models with a different Mark of Chaos treat each other as Suspicious Allies. However, models with the Mark of Khorne and Slaanesh, or Tzeentch and Nurgle, treat each other as Desperate Allies, respectively.
Characters without a Mark of Chaos may not join units that have one.
• Mark of Khorne: Models with the Mark of Khorne have the Frenzy special rule.
• Mark of Nurgle: Models with the Mark of Nurgle add +1 to their Toughness.
• Mark of Slaanesh: Models with the Mark of Slaanesh have the Immunity (Psychology) special rule and may re-roll the lowest dice on their charge and pursuit distances.
• Mark of Tzeentch: Models with the Mark of Tzeentch have a Magical Ward (6+) and the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: WILL OF CHAOS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule have the Cold-blooded special rule when taking Panic tests.

magicItems.name: CHAOS DAEMONSWORD
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon adds D3 to their Strength and has an extra D3 Attacks, to a maximum of 10 (roll separately for these values at the start of each round). However, every To Wound roll of a 1 made by this character in close combat is resolved against themselves.

magicItems.name: RENDING SWORD
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon may re-roll failed To Wound rolls and have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: VAMPIRIC AXE
magicItems.description: For each unsaved Wound the wielder inflicts with this weapon, they regain one Wound lost earlier during the game.

magicItems.name: HELLFIRE SWORD
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon have the Flaming Attacks and Ignores Armour Saves special rules. After all close combat blows have been struck, roll a D6 for every foe slain by the Hellfire Sword – on the roll of a 6, the slain foe’s body explodes, inflicting an additional D6 Strength 4 hits on the enemy unit with the Flaming Attacks special rule. Unsaved Wounds inflicted in this way count towards the combat result. At the end of each of the wielder’s turns, roll a D6; on the roll of a 1, they suffer one Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: OBSIDIAN DREAD-GLAIVE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: TASKMASTER'S SCOURGE
magicItems.description: If the wielder of this weapon joins a unit, that unit may re-roll failed charge and pursuit rolls.

magicItems.name: AETHERSWORD
magicItems.description: The Aethersword gives the wielder the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. In addition, no Parry saves from shields may be taken against it either.

magicItems.name: DAGGER OF THE DARK PANTHEON
magicItems.description: For each unsaved Wound the wielder causes in close combat, they gain +1 Power Dice or Dispel in the next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: THE FATHER OF BLADES
magicItems.description: All To Hit rolls of 1 directed against the wielder of this weapon in close combat instead hit the attacking model.

magicItems.name: DOOMBRINGER BLADE
magicItems.description: After deployment is complete, choose one enemy Character or Monster. All friendly units gain +1 To Wound in close combat against the chosen model.

magicItems.name: SOUL CLEAVER
magicItems.description: Any model that suffers an unsaved Wound from this weapon must pass a Toughness test or suffer an additional wound with no saves allowed. This additional wound does not cause an additional Toughness test.

magicItems.name: VOID ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Ethereal special rule. However, they may take no other Magic Items.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF MORRSLIEB
magicItems.description: The Armour of Morrslieb gives the wearer a 4+ invulnerable save against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE DAMNED
magicItems.description: Enemy models must re-roll successful To Hit rolls in close combat against the wearer of this armour.

magicItems.name: BRONZE ARMOUR OF ZHRAKK
magicItems.description: The Bronze Armour of Zhrakk gives the wearer the Unbreakable special rule. However, no other model may use the model's Leadership.

magicItems.name: IDOLATROUS PLACKART
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour have a Magical Ward (5+).

magicItems.name: NULL PLATE
magicItems.description: All close combat and missile attacks targeting the wearer of this armour suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: SKINHIDDEN PLATE
magicItems.description: The Skinhidden Plate gives the wearer the Natural Armour (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: CRIMSON ARMOUR OF DARGAN
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Crimson Armour of Dargan gains the Immunity (Killing Blow/Multiple Wounds) special rule against close combat attacks and a Magical Ward (6+).

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF TORTURED SOULS
magicItems.description: The Armour of Tortured Souls gives the wearer +1 Toughness against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: HELM OF THE OPPRESSOR
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. All enemy units in base contact the wearer of this helmet must roll an additional D6 when taking Leadership tests and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: WEIRD PLATE
magicItems.description: All models attempting to strike the wearer of this armour suffer -1 Attack (to a minimum of 1).

magicItems.name: DESECRATOR GAUNTLETS
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. All enemy Wizards within 12" of the wearer of these gauntlets suffer a -2 casting penalty. In addition, the wearer gains +1 To Wound against Wizards in close combat.

magicItems.name: HELM OF MANY EYES
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. The wearer gains the Always Strikes First and Stupidity special rules.

magicItems.name: FUSED ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour automatically passes all Characteristic tests (except Leadership tests).

magicItems.name: HELM OF ELDRITCH COMMAND
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. Whenever the wearer successfully dispels an enemy spell (except summoning spells), they may attempt to cast that spell themselves (limited by their Wizard level as normal) in their next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF TEETH
magicItems.description: If the bearer of this shield makes a successful Parry save, they immediately get to make an additional Attack.

magicItems.name: DAEMON-FORGED BARDING
magicItems.description: The bearer's mount gains the Devastating Charge special rule.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF EVERLASTING CONQUEST
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Crown of Everlasting Conquest gains the Inspiring Presence (6) and Regeneration (4+) special rules.

magicItems.name: GAZE OF THE GODS
magicItems.description: The Gaze of the Gods gives the wearer a Magical Ward (4+). However, if the model flees for any reason, the model is turned into a Chaos Spawn with the same number of wounds remaining as the character had, after working out the Flee move. If you do not have a Spawn model to replace the character then he simply counts as slain. For Victory Points purposes, the character is not counted as slain or below half Wounds unless the Spawn he has turned into is slain or is below half Wounds.

magicItems.name: THE BOOK OF SECRETS
magicItems.description: The Book of Secrets allows the Wizard to choose an additional spell from each of the Lores of Fire, Shadow and Death, following the normal rules for choosing spells. This does not give them any additional access to any Signature spells. In addition, they get +1 to channel power dice, but do not channel any dispel dice. If the bearer ever miscasts, roll 2D6 on the Miscast table and choose the highest result.

magicItems.name: INFERNAL PUPPET
magicItems.description: Whenever any Wizard on the battlefield miscasts while casting a spell, the bearer of the Infernal Puppet may choose to modify any rolls on the Miscast table made by that Wizard by up to D3 each time.

magicItems.name: ROD OF THE DAMNED
magicItems.description: This item contains The Summoning spell from the Lore of Chaos.

magicItems.name: SCEPTRE OF POWER
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a +1 casting and dispelling bonus. However, if they roll any natural double when casting or dispelling, they suffer a Strength 3 Hit which Ignores Armour Saves after the effects of the roll have been resolved.

magicItems.name: TOME OF THE DARK GODS
magicItems.description: This item may not be taken by a model with a Mark of Chaos. The bearer of this item may choose their spells from a combination of the Lore of Chaos, Nurgle, Slaanesh and Tzeentch.

magicItems.name: GRIMOIRE OF OGVOLD
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Loremaster special rule. However, they may only attempt to cast a number of spells equal to their Wizard Level each Magic phase.

magicItems.name: BLASPHEMOUS AMULET
magicItems.description: At the start of every close combat phase, all enemy models in base contact with the bearer of the Blasphemous Amulet must pass a Toughness test or suffer one Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. This has no effect against Animated Constructs.

magicItems.name: FAITHLESS CHARM
magicItems.description: The Faithless Charm gives the bearer the Always Strike First and Killing Blow special rules. However, if they fail any Leadership test, they lose Always Strike First and gain Frenzy and Always Strikes Last instead. The bearer cannot lose their Frenzy.

magicItems.name: MARK OF THE ALL-FAVOURED
magicItems.description: At the start of each of your turns, the bearer of this item can choose one Mark of Chaos, whose effects lasts until the start of your next turn. This has no effect on a model that already has a Mark of Chaos.

magicItems.name: REALMWARPER'S TWIST-RUNE
magicItems.description: At the start of any of your turns, choose one terrain feature within 12" of the bearer. All enemy models within 1" of that terrain feature must take a Dangerous Terrain test, which fails on a 1-2.

magicItems.name: STAR OF CHAOS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll one failed To Hit, To Wound, armour or invulnerable save roll in each phase.

magicItems.name: CHALICE OF CHAOS
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Chalice of Chaos may drink from it at the start of any phase. If they choose to do so, roll a D6 and consult the table below.
D6 | Result:
1 | Unworthy Fool: The character immediately suffers a Wound, with no saves of any kind allowed.
2 | Daemonic Strength: The character gains the Killing Blow special rule until the end of the turn.
3 | Regenerating Flesh: The character gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule until the end of the turn.
4 | Inhuman Speed: The character gains the Always Strikes First special rule until the end of the turn.
5 | Dark Fortune: The character may re-roll failed armour and invulnerable saves until the end of the turn.
6 | Divine Greatness: The character gains the Magical Ward (4+) and Stubborn special rules until the end of the turn.

magicItems.name: PENDANT OF DAMNATION
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains +1 Attack for every Wound they suffer during the game. If their lost Wounds are restored, this bonus is lost.

magicItems.name: FAVOUR OF THE GODS
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a +1 bonus when rolling on the Eye of the Gods table.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE GODS
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Banner of the Gods causes Terror, and any unit joined by them gains the Unbreakable special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE DEMAGOGUE
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 12" of this standard gain +1 Leadership.

magicItems.name: DOOM TOTEM
magicItems.description: All enemy units with Line of Sight to the Doom Totem suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This standard has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: BLASPHEMOUS ICON
magicItems.description: Enemy units in base contact with this standard must roll an additional dice when taking Leadership tests and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF WRATH
magicItems.description: The Banner of Wrath contains a magic missile with a range of 24". If cast, it causes D6 Strength 4 hits with the Lightning Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: ICON OF DARKNESS
magicItems.description: All enemy missile fire targeting the unit carrying this standard suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: BANE SPEAR
magicItems.description: This weapon gives +1 Strength for each enemy model in base contact with the wielder.

magicItems.name: BERSERKER SWORD
magicItems.description: The Berserker Sword gives the wielder +1 Attack for every enemy model in base contact. In a challenge, it only confers +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF ENDLESS BLOODSHED
magicItems.description: Whenever the wielder of this weapon causes an unsaved Wound, they may make an additional Attack (up to a maximum of +3). These attacks can generate additional Attacks.

magicItems.name: AXE OF KHORNE
magicItems.description: This axe confers +1 Strength and the Killing Blow special rule upon the bearer.

magicItems.name: GORECLEAVER
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Armour Piercing (1) and Multiple Wounds (2) special rules.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF BLOOD
magicItems.description: For every unsaved Wound caused by the Blade of Blood, the wielder may take a Strength test. If passed, the wielder regains 1 Wound previously lost during the game. However, if the test is failed, the wielder loses 1 Wound with no saves allowed instead.

magicItems.name: SPELLEATER SHIELD
magicItems.description: The Spelleater Shield gives the bearer the Magic Resistance (2) special rule. In addition, roll a D6 each time a spell is cast at the bearer of the Spelleater Shield and is dispelled. On the roll of a 4+, the spell is destroyed and the enemy Wizard may not cast it for the rest of the battle.

magicItems.name: THE BLOOD-FORGED ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item cannot have their armour reduced below 4+.

magicItems.name: THE SKULL-HELM OF KHORNE
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. All enemy units within 6" of the wearer must re-roll successful Break tests.

magicItems.name: BLOODSKULL PENDANT
magicItems.description: Instead of making his normal attacks for that round, the bearer of the Bloodskull Pendant may choose to inflict an automatic Strength 8 Hit with the Killing Blow special rule on every enemy model in base contact.

magicItems.name: THE BRAZEN RUNE
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item gains a 2+ invulnerable save against spells.

magicItems.name: MARK OF THE DESTROYER
magicItems.description: The wielder doubles their number of Attacks (to a maximum of 10). However, if the wearer fails to kill at least one model each close combat phase in which they are part of, they are automatically turned into a Spawn of Khorne at the end of that close combat phase. Remove the model as a casualty, and place a Spawn of Chaos model within 1" of their last position. This Spawn is under your control for the rest of the game, and is not worth any additional Victory Points. If no Spawn model can be placed, the model is only removed as a casualty.

magicItems.name: BLOOD RUNE
magicItems.description: All wounds caused in close combat by the bearer of this item counts as double for the purpose of combat resolution, up to a maximum of +3.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF BURNING BLOOD
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item and any unit they are with gains the Vanguard special rule.

magicItems.name: THE BLACK TONGUE
magicItems.description: The Black Tongue can be used whenever an enemy Wizard fails to cast a spell. When used, the spell counts as having been Miscast. The model bearing the Black Tongue then suffers a wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF BLOOD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed charge distances.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF RAGE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Banner of Rage can never lose their Frenzy. In addition, it may re-roll failed Break Tests.

magicItems.name: RUSTFANG
magicItems.description: Any enemy unit in base contact with the wielder of this weapon suffer a -1 penalty to their armour saves.

magicItems.name: FILTH MACE
magicItems.description: Close combat attacks made with the Filth Mace have the Poisoned Attacks special rule. Once the wielder has killed an enemy model in close combat, they immediately gain the Terror special rule and, from the start of the next Close Combat phase (friend or foe), all subsequent Attacks made with the Filth Mace have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: GLAIVE OF PUTREFACTION
magicItems.description: Every unsaved Wound caused by the Glaive of Putrefaction against Characters, Monstrous Creatures or Monsters makes the victim suffer -1 to their Strength and Toughness for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: THE SPLITHORN HELM
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. Enemy models suffer -1 To Wound against this wearer in close combat and with missile attacks.

magicItems.name: THE SHIELD OF GROWTHS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this shield may re-roll failed armour saves if the Strength of the attack is equal to or higher than the bearer's modified armour save (for example, if the bearer is Hit by a Strength 4 Attack and their modified armour save is 4+).

magicItems.name: SPORE CENSER
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeting the wearer or the unit they are with suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: THE FOETID SHROUD
magicItems.description: All close combat attacks targeting the wearer of this item suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: ROD OF CORRUPTION
magicItems.description: The Rod of Corruption contains a direct damage spell with a range of 24". The target unit suffers D6 Strength 2 Hits with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: FLESH PEALER
magicItems.description: At the start of your Magic phase, all enemy units within 6" of the bearer of this item suffer D6 Strength 3 Hits which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: THE BILEHEART
magicItems.description: Every time the bearer of this item suffers an unsaved Wound, the model that struck the blow suffer a Strength 5 Hit which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: THE EYE OF NURGLE
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any round of close combat. Roll 2D6, if the result is 7, then one model in base contact of your choosing suffers D3 Wounds which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: THE CARRION DIRGE
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any of your turns. Once used, all enemy units within 12" suffer -2 to their Leadership for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: THE FECUND FLASK
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your turns. Roll a D6, on a 2+, the model immediately recovers all Wounds (ignoring any additional Wounds from mounts) up to their starting value. On the roll of a 1, the bearer gains the Stupidity special rule for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: FESTERING SHROUD
magicItems.description: All units in base contact with the unit carrying the Festering Shroud must re-roll successful rolls To Wound. This standard has no effect on models with the Mark of Nurgle or Animated Constructs.

magicItems.name: ERODING ICON
magicItems.description: All enemy units in base contact with this standard counts the armour save modifier from their Strength or Armour Piercing attacks as being 1 point worse than normal.

magicItems.name: GILELLION'S SOULNETTER
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +2 Attacks. In addition, all enemy units in base contact that fail their break test roll one D6 less than normal for their flee distance.

magicItems.name: SLAANESH'S BLADE
magicItems.description: All attacks with this weapon have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. In addition, the wielder gains the Parry (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: WHIP OF PLEASURE
magicItems.description: The Whip of Pleasure gives the wielder +1 Attack. In addition, the wielder gains the Always Strikes First special rule in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: WHIP OF SUBVERSION
magicItems.description: If an enemy Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster takes an unsaved wound from the Whip of Subversion and that model has not yet made its attacks for that round, then you may force it to allocate its attacks upon itself or other models from its own side.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF ECSTASY
magicItems.description: Each time the Blade of Ecstasy inflicts an unsaved wound on a model, that model must pass a Strength test or be removed from the game.

magicItems.name: BREATHTAKER
magicItems.description: Each time an enemy Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster is Hit by this weapon, they suffer -1 Attack for the duration of this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: JEWEL OF DENIAL
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a Magical Ward (5+). In addition, each time they make a successful Ward save in close combat, they gain +1 combat resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: THE BEGUILING GEM
magicItems.description: At the start of each round of close combat, all enemy models in base contact with the wielder must pass a Psychology test or lose 1 Attack.

magicItems.name: CAMEO OF THE DARK PRINCE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item and any unit they are with gain the Cold-blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: SCEPTRE OF DOMINATION
magicItems.description: The Sceptre of Domination contains the Pavane of Slaanesh spell from the Lore of Slaanesh.

magicItems.name: BINDINGS OF SLAANESH
magicItems.description: Enemies cannot refuse challenges issued by the wearer of the Bindings of Slaanesh. In addition, they are subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule in challenges (including mounts).

magicItems.name: RING OF SENSATION
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains +1 Attack for every enemy spell that is successfully cast within 12". The effect lasts until the start of the enemy's next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: THE ROD OF MISRULE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Inspiring Presence (6) and Stupidity special rules.

magicItems.name: THE CROWN OF DARK SECRETS
magicItems.description: After deployment, choose one enemy Character. The bearer of this item may re-roll failed To Hit rolls against that model for the duration of the game.

magicItems.name: PENDANT OF SLAANESH
magicItems.description: No other character may join the same unit as the bearer and he cannot join units that already contain a character. For each unsaved Wound the bearer suffers, he gains +1 Attack for the rest of the battle.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF SCREAMING FLESH
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Devastating Charge special rule.

magicItems.name: RAPTUROUS STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Rapturous Standard gains the Unbreakable special rule.

magicItems.name: ICON OF INFINITE EXCESS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard and any enemy unit in base contact with them gain +1 To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: SECRET-EATER
magicItems.description: Each time the wielder of this weapon rolls a 6 To Hit, they may re-roll one failed To Hit, To Wound, armour or Ward save this round.

magicItems.name: AMBITION'S END
magicItems.description: This weapon has Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule against Characters. In addition, each time they cause an unsaved Wound against a Wizard, that model loses a Wizard level.

magicItems.name: WICKED SHARD
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon can re-roll all failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: PARADOXICAL SHIELD
magicItems.description: This shield gives the bearer the Parry (5+) special rule even while mount. However, the bearer must re-roll successful armour saves.

magicItems.name: GOLDEN EYE OF TZEENTCH
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a Magical Ward (3+) against all missile attacks.

magicItems.name: CRYSTAL PENDANT
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll failed Ward saves.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF CHANGE
magicItems.description: The bearer can re-roll any dice of their choice when casting or dispelling. However, if the bearer casts a spell with Ultimate Power using the staff's re-roll ability, the staff will cease working for the rest of the battle.

magicItems.name: SOULDRAUGHT
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any Magic phase. For the duration of this Magic phase, roll an additional D6 when casting or dispelling spells and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: MIRROR OF KNOWLEDGE
magicItems.description: The bearer can pick any enemy unit within 24" at the beginning of each of his Magic phases. The opponent must reveal all Magic Items and Hidden models in it.

magicItems.name: NEXUS STAFF
magicItems.description: For each unsaved Wound caused by the wielder in close combat, they gain a +1 casting bonus in their next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: BLOOD OF TZEENTCH
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Blood of Tzeentch may re-roll one casting dice per turn, provided it was not originally a roll of a 1.

magicItems.name: WARP MIRROR
magicItems.description: All bonuses that are not from Magic Items, spells or mounts that occur in the first round of close combat (such as Charge Bonus, Mighty Blow, Devastating Charge, Impact Hits etc.) are swapped between the bearer of this item (and any unit they are with) and any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer.

magicItems.name: FRACTURED CLASP
magicItems.description: All enemy units in base contact with the bearer of this item suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill and Leadership.

magicItems.name: DAEMONHEART
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any round of close combat. Once used, the wielder gains +2 Strength and +2 Attacks. Roll a D6 after resolving all attacks; on the roll of 1, the bearer suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: TIMESLIP PENDANT
magicItems.description: This item may be used after the wearer has made all their normal close combat attacks. When used, they may fight an additional time.

magicItems.name: BLASTED STANDARD
magicItems.description: Each time the unit carrying the Blasted Standard suffers a hit from a shooting attack, roll a D6 immediately before rolling To Wound. On the roll of 2+, the Strength of that hit is halved. However, if the result is a 1, the Strength of that hit is instead doubled. Attacks that do not roll To Wound, or that wound automatically, are not affected by the Blasted Standard.

magicItems.name: GLAMOUR FETISH
magicItems.description: All enemy units within 12" of the bearer of this standard suffer -1 Leadership when taking Break tests.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF CHAOS
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a Wizard successfully cast a spell from the Lore of Chaos, the Wizard’s Weapon Skill, Toughness and Leadership are increased by 1 until the start of their next Magic phase.

spells.name: THE SUMMONING
spells.description: The Summoning is a magic missile with a range of 18" that causes 2D6 Strength 3 hits with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

spells.name: DAEMONIC FAMILIARS
spells.description: Daemonic Familiars is a hex spell that targets one unit in base contact with the Wizard. The target suffer 2D6 Strength 2 hits with the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

spells.name: GIFT OF CHAOS
spells.description: Gift of Chaos is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 12". Each target suffers D6 Strength 3 Hits.

spells.name: VEIL OF GLOOM
spells.description: Veil of Gloom is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit gains a Magical Ward (5+) against missile attacks until the start of your next Magic phase.

spells.name: VISION OF TORMENT
spells.description: Vision of Torment is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target must pass a Psychology test or be unable to voluntarily move or shoot until the start of the caster's next turn.

spells.name: WINDS OF CHAOS
spells.description: Winds of Chaos is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target suffers -2 to their Movement until the start of the caster's next turn.

spells.name: BINDING DAMNATION
spells.description: Binding Damnation is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target suffers -3 to their Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill (to a minimum of 1) until the start of the caster's next turn.

spells.name: MASK OF DARKNESS
spells.description: Mask of Darkness is a conveyance spell with a range of 12". The target is immediately picked up and may be moved to any point on the battlefield within 12" of its original position, just like a summoning spell.

spells.name: VEIL OF CORRUPTION
spells.description: Veil of Corruption is a direct damage area spell with a range of 24" that uses the large round template. All models hit by the template suffer a Strength 3 hit.

spells.name: RUINOUS VIGOUR
spells.description: Ruinous Vigour is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains +1 Movement, Toughness and Initiative until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: CHAOTIC CONDUIT
spells.description: Chaotic Conduit is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains +1 To Hit and To Wound in close combat until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: SPITE-TONGUE CURSE
spells.description: Spite-tongue Curse is a direct damage spell with a range of 12" that causes 3D6 Strength 5 hits. However, if the spell fails to reach its casting value, the caster suffers 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: VORTEX OF CHAOS
spells.description: Remains in play. Vortex Of Chaos is a magical vortex that uses the large round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move suffer a Strength 4 hit.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF NURGLE
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a Wizard successfully casts a spell from the Lore of Nurgle, roll a D6 after resolving the spell's effect(s). On the roll of a 6, the Wizard or one friendly Character within 6" gain +1 Wound for the remainder of the game.

spells.name: STREAM OF CORRUPTION
spells.description: Stream of Corruption is a direct damage spell. The caster makes a Breath Weapon Attack. This may be cast in close combat, following the normal rules for Breath Weapons. All models Hit must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

spells.name: MIASMA OF PESTILENCE
spells.description: Miasma of Pestilence is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase, all enemy units in base contact with the target unit reduce their Weapon Skill and Initiative by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

spells.name: BLADES OF PUTREFACTION
spells.description: Blades of Putrefaction is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit’s close combat attacks gain the Poisoned Attacks special rule until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: MAGNIFICENT BUBOUES
spells.description: Magnificent Buboes is a magic missile with a range of 18" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target suffers one Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

spells.name: CURSE OF THE LEPER
spells.description: Curse of the Leper is an augment/hex spell with a range of 24". If cast on a friendly unit, it increases the target unit’s Toughness by 1 until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. If cast on an enemy unit, it reduces the target unit’s Toughness by 1 (to a minimum of 1) until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: PLAGUE SQUALL
spells.description: Plague Squall is a direct damage area spell with a range of 24" that uses the large round template; it scatters like a stone thrower. If a misfire is rolled, the caster suffers 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. Any model hit suffers a Strength 1 Hit with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

spells.name: RANCID VISITATIONS
spells.description: Rancid Visitations is a magic missile with a range of 18" that inflicts D6 Strength 5 hits. The target unit must then immediately pass a Toughness test or suffer a further D6 hits. The target must keep taking Toughness tests until it passes, or is removed as a casualty.

spells.name: ROTBOMB
spells.description: Rotbomb is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target's armour save is lowered by two points for the rest of the game. Rotbomb can be repeatedly cast on the same target, reducing its armour save by a further -2 each time.

spells.name: CLOYING QUAGMIRE
spells.description: Cloying Quagmire is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". All models in the unit must take an Initiative test. Those that fail must then take an armour save. If passed, they are removed as casualties, with no saves allowed. Models without armour count as passing on a 6. This spell has no effect on models with the Fly, Ethereal or Strider special rules.

spells.name: FLESHY ABUNDANCE
spells.description: Fleshy Abundance is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase, the target has the Regeneration (5+) special rule (to a maximum of a 3+ save for Daemons of Nurgle).

spells.name: GRANDFATHER NURGLE'S CIRCLE OF LIFE
spells.description: Grandfather Nurgle's Circle of Life is a direct damage spell with a range of 24" that causes D6 hits that wound on a 4+ with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. For each unsaved Wound caused, one friendly unit within 6" of the caster instantly recovers 1 Wounds' worth of models slain earlier in the battle, just like a summoning spell.

spells.name: PLAGUE WIND
spells.description: Remains in play. Plague Wind is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move must pass a Toughness test or suffer a single Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

spells.name: ROT, GLORIOUS ROT
spells.description: Rot, Glorious Rot is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 18". Each target suffers D6 Strength 3 Hits with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF SLAANESH
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a Wizard successfully casts a spell from the Lore of Slaanesh on an enemy unit, the target suffers D6 Strength 3 Hits after resolving all effects of the spell.

spells.name: LASH OF SLAANESH
spells.description: Lash of Slaanesh is a direct damage spell. Extend a straight line, 24" in length, within the caster’s forward arc and directly from their base. Each model in the way (determined using the line template) suffers a Strength 4 hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. Any unit that suffers a casualty from this spell may not march in its next Movement phase.

spells.name: HYSTERICAL FRENZY
spells.description: Remains in play. Hysterical Frenzy is an augment/hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target gains the Frenzy special rule (which is not lost if the unit is defeated in close combat) and suffers D6 Strength 3 hits at the end of each of the caster’s Magic phases.

spells.name: PAVANE OF SLAANESH
spells.description: Pavane of Slaanesh is a direct damage spell with a range of 12" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). If successfully cast, the target must pass a Leadership test on their own unmodified Leadership or suffer 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves for every point they failed the test by.

spells.name: SUCCOUR OF CHAOS
spells.description: Succour of Chaos is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Always Strikes First special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: TITILLATING DELUSIONS
spells.description: Remains in Play. Titillating Delusions is a hex spell with a range of 24". Place a marker (this has a Line of Sight value of 1) within 24". While the spell is in effect, the target must pass a Leadership test at the start of each of their Movement phases or be forced to move towards the target as quickly as possible. The spell is automatically dispelled as soon as the unit reaches the marker or loses Line of Sight to it.

spells.name: SLOTHFUL STUPOR
spells.description: Slothful Stupor is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target suffers -2 Leadership and gains the Stupidity special rule until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: ACQUIESCENCE
spells.description: Acquiescence is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit is subject to the Always Strikes Last and Random Movement (D6) special rules until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: DELICIOUS EXCRUCIATION
spells.description: Delicious Excruciation is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all models in the target are automatically Hit in close combat and gain the Unbreakable special rule.

spells.name: SLICING SHARDS
spells.description: Slicing Shards is a magic missile with a range of 24" that inflicts D6 Strength 4 hits with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. The target must then immediately pass a Leadership test or suffer a further D6 hits. The target must keep taking Leadership tests until it passes, or is removed as a casualty.

spells.name: PHANTASMAGORIA
spells.description: Phantasmagoria is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase, the target unit must roll an additional D6 whenever it takes a Leadership test, discarding the lowest result rolled.

spells.name: CACOPHONIC CHOIR
spells.description: Cacophonic Choir is a hex spell with a range of 12". The target takes 3D6 hits that wound on a 4+ which Ignores Armour saves. If at least one unsaved Wound is caused, the target is subject to the Always Strikes Last and Random Movement (D6) special rules until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: ECSTATIC SEIZURES
spells.description: Ecstatic Seizures is a direct damage spell with a range of 12". All models in the target unit must pass a Strength test or suffer 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: SONG OF SEDUCTION
spells.description: Remains in play. Song of Seduction is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, this unit is wholly under the caster's control. It may move and shoot (but not charge, cast spells or channel dice) during the enemy's turn as if it were your own unit. At the end of each subsequent Magic phase, the unit must take a Leadership test. If passed, the spell is dispelled. The spell is immediately dispelled if the unit becomes engaged in close combat.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF TZEENTCH
loresOfMagic.attribute: When a spell from the Lore of Tzeentch is successfully cast you may add a Power Dice to your pool for each natural 6 that was rolled to cast the spell, after resolving the spell's effect(s).

spells.name: BLUE FIRE OF TZEENTCH
spells.description: Blue Fire of Tzeentch is a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes D6 Strength D6+1 hits with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

spells.name: BALEFUL TRANSMOGRIFICATION
spells.description: Baleful Transmogrification is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". The target suffers D3 Strength D6 Hits which Ignores Armour Saves. If a 3 is rolled for the number of Hits, it suffers an additional D3 hits.

spells.name: BOON OF TZEENTCH
spells.description: Boon of Tzeentch is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself. The Wizard immediately gains D3+1 Power dice, that only they may use.

spells.name: PANDEMONIUM
spells.description: Pandemonium is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase, the target unit must use the lowest Leadership value in the unit (including that of mounts) and cannot benefit from the Inspiring Presence or Hold Your Ground! abilities.

spells.name: PINK FIRE OF TZEENTCH
spells.description: Pink Fire of Tzeentch is a direct damage spell. Place the teardrop-shaped template with its narrow end touching the front of the Wizard’s base and the large end aimed at the target. Roll 2D6 and move the template directly forwards the number of inches indicated. All models underneath the template suffer a Strength D6+1 hit (roll once and apply the result to all models) with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

spells.name: BOLT OF CHANGE
spells.description: Bolt of Change is a magic missile with a range of 24". It inflicts a single Strength D6+4 hit with the Multiple Wounds (D3), Ignores Armour Saves and Flaming Attacks special rules, and then penetrates ranks in the same manner as a shot from a bolt thrower.

spells.name: SHIELD OF FATE
spells.description: Shield of Fate is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target may re-roll armour and Ward save rolls of 1 until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: FOLD REALITY
spells.description: Fold Reality is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit instantly recovers D3+1 Wounds' worth of models slain earlier in the battle, just like a summoning spell. However, if a 1 is rolled, the target suffers D3+1 Wounds with no saves allowed instead.

spells.name: GLEAN MAGIC
spells.description: Glean Magic is a hex spell that targets a single enemy Wizard within 18". The caster and the target both roll a D6 and add their Wizard level to the score. If the caster rolls higher, the target suffers a Strength 4 hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule and loses one Wizard level (along with one spell). The caster gains access to this spell (unless it is a summoning spell) and can cast it themselves for the remainder of the game (using Boon of Magic as the Lore Attribute).

spells.name: TZEENTCH'S FIRESTORM
spells.description: Tzeentch's Firestorm is a direct damage area with a range of 30" that uses the small round template. All models hit by the template suffer a Strength D6+1 hit (roll once and apply the result to all models) with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

spells.name: DAEMONFIRE VORTEX
spells.description: Remains in play. Daemonfire Vortex is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move suffers a Strength D6+1 hit (roll once for each unit and apply the result to all models in that unit) with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

spells.name: TREASON OF TZEENTCH
spells.description: Treason of Tzeentch is a hex spell with a range of 24". All models in the unit immediately make a number of close combat attacks equal to the models' Attack characteristic (in addition to any extra Attacks from weapons) against the unit itself. Roll To Hit, To Wound and take saves as normal. The caster may choose which of the unit's weapons is used for these attacks. Parry or Dodge save does not apply, and neither do any special rules that only applies in the first round of close combat.

spells.name: INFERNAL GATEWAY
spells.description: Infernal Gateway is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". The target suffers 2D6 Strength 2D6 hits with the Flaming Attacks special rule. Roll for the Strength first. If an 11 or 12 is rolled when determining the spell’s Strength value, the hits are resolved at Strength 10, and the unit suffers 3D6 hits rather than 2D6.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: MANTLE OF CHAOS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Any missile attacks targeting the character or the unit they are with have their Strength value halved, rounding up. This has no effect against Magical Attacks.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: DIABOLIC SPLENDOUR
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Any successful Leadership tests taken by an enemy unit in base contact with the character must be re- rolled. This mutation cannot be combined with Fearsome Aura.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: FEARSOME AURA
gifts_of_the_gods.description: All enemy units within 6" of the character suffer -1 to their Leadership.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: TERRIFYING APPEARANCE
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Terror special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: WINGS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Fly (10) special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: FLAMING BREATH
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains a Strength 3 Breath Weapon that has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: COMMAND OF THE GODS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Leadership.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: DAEMON-FLESH
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character cannot be wounded on better than a 3+.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: ENCHANTING AURA
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Enemy models in base contact with the character are subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: MASSIVE BULK
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Wound.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: MASTER OF MORTALS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule that affects Humans.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: UNHOLY RESILIENCE
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Toughness.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: AURA OF CHAOS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains a Magical Ward (6+).

gifts_of_the_gods.name: BESTIAL VISAGE
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Fear special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: DARK FURY
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Attack.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: EXTRA ARM
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character may wield both a weapon that Requires Two Hands and a shield at the same time, benefitting from both pieces of equipment. This mutation cannot be combined with Tentacle.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: SLAUGHTERER'S STRENGTH
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Strength.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: SOUL FEEDER
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Roll a D6 for every unsaved Wound the character inflicts on an enemy unit in close combat. For each result of a 6 rolled, they immediately regain a single lost Wound.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: CHAOS FAMILIAR
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character knows one more spell than normal for their level.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: DISTENDABLE MAW
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Instead of making his usual attacks, the character can choose to make a special attack against a single Infantry model. If the attack hits, the enemy model must pass an Initiative test. If this test is failed, the victim suffers D3 Wounds with no saves allowed.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: POISONOUS SLIME
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Poisoned Attacks and Immunity (Poisoned Attacks) special rules.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: SCALED SKIN
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Natural Armour (6+) special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: ACID ICHOR
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Whenever this character suffers an unsaved Wound in close combat, the model that inflicted that Hit suffers a Strength 4 hit.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: BURNING BODY
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Flaming Attacks and Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rules.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: CLOVEN HOOVES
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Movement. This mutation cannot be combined with Serpent Body.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: FLAMES OF CHAOS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: HORNS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Impact Hits (1) special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: MURDEROUS MUTATION
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +1 Weapon Skill.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: TENTACLE
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Choose one enemy model in base contact with the character at the start of each round of close combat – that model suffers -1 Attacks. However, the character is not allowed to use a shield or any weapon that Requires Two Hands.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: UNHOLY STRIKE
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Instead of attacking normally, the character can choose to make a single special Attack. If they do so, and the Attack hits, the hit is resolved at double the character's Strength and has the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: BLOODCURDLING ROAR
gifts_of_the_gods.description: At the start of the first round of close combat, all enemy units in base contact with the character suffer D6 Strength 2 hits which Ignores Armour saves.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: BLOOD FEVER
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character will never lose their Frenzy for any reason. In addition, any unit, friend or foe, that is in base contact with them at the start of their Movement phase becomes subject to Frenzy for the rest of that turn. If they already have the Frenzy special rule, they instead gain +1 Attack, but will have to re-roll any successful Berserk Rage roll.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: FURY OF THE BLOOD GOD
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains the Hatred special rule. Any Wizard within 12" of the character suffer -D3 to each of their casting rolls.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: DEAFENING BELLOW
gifts_of_the_gods.description: On the turn that the character charges, all enemy units in base contact suffer -1 To Hit in close combat.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: STREAM OF CORRUPTION
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains a Breath Weapon. All models Hit must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: NURGLING INFESTATION
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Each model that attacks the character in close combat suffer an automatic Strength 3 hit after the attacker’s hits have been worked out. This hit occurs even if the character with the Nurgling Infestation is slain and any wounds caused count towards combat resolution.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: SECONDARY JAWS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains a special attack at Strength 2 with the Always Strikes First and Ignores Armour Saves special rules.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: NURGLE'S ROT
gifts_of_the_gods.description: At the start of every close combat phase, every enemy model in base contact with the character suffers a single Strength 1 hit with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: HELLSHRIEK
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character can use this ability at the start of any Magic phase, immediately after rolling for the Winds of Magic. All enemy Wizards within 18" must immediately roll 2D6 on the Miscast table.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: WORD OF AGONY
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Once per game, at the beginning of the Close Combat phase (before challenges are issued), the character can choose a model in base contact. That model takes D6 Strength 4 hits which Ignores Armour saves.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: SERPENT BODY
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character gains +2 Movement, +1 Initiative and the Swiftstride special rule. This mutation cannot be combined with Cloven Hooves.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: SOPORIFIC MUSK
gifts_of_the_gods.description: When a unit flees from the character or the unit they are with, the fleeing unit rolls an extra D6 and discards the highest dice roll.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: ALLURE OF SLAANESH
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Any opponent wishing to strike the character in close combat must first pass a Psychology test before rolling To Hit. If the test is failed, that model cannot make any close combat attacks that phase. This does not affect Attacks that do not roll To Hit.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: TENDRILS OF TZEENTCH
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character may re-roll a single power or dispel dice per player turn. This may potentially prevent a Miscast.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: PROTEAN FORM
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The Champion has the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: CONJOINED HOMUNCULUS
gifts_of_the_gods.description: Once per turn, the character may choose to add +D3 to his casting result after attempting to cast a spell. This extra dice cannot cause a Miscast or count towards Ultimate Power.

gifts_of_the_gods.name: THIRD EYE OF TZEENTCH
gifts_of_the_gods.description: The character re-rolls Ward save results of 1.
